source: shipped with the repository, pose from benchmark/presets/presets_by_scene.json (city-street/hotel-m)
note: Captured in Solid with textures, not Material Preview. This scene costs roughly 700 seconds a frame in Material Preview under software OpenGL whatever the resolution, so a ten frame sweep of it is not practical there. A run in Material Preview will refuse this entry and sweep instead, which is correct: recapture it on a machine with a GL driver to replace this.
